narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Sixty four times sixteen is three steps times two steps, so four to the power six.
<bookmark mark='climb'/>Multiplying by sixteen climbs two more steps from sixty four.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Steps add when we multiply. They do not multiply, so the bubble is wrong.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble shows 3 × 2 = 6; a marker climbs two steps from 64; the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='think'/>On a power line, multiplying climbs and dividing goes down.
<bookmark mark='yours'/>Your turn. Use the power line of two to find sixty four divided by eight.
removed_beats.on_screen: the line multiply climbs, divide goes down appears; a power line of 2 and 64 ÷ 8 appear with an empty box
